description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Supernatural Stamina.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Supernatural Stamina.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
